about: Hand-labelled claims for the server's claim checks. 'supported' claims must be kept. 'unsupported' claims should be discarded; caughtToday records whether the current checks manage it, so the known gaps are written down and a change in either direction fails the test.

UN.text: Sudan: Driver killed in aerial attack on aid trucks in South Kordofan. The World Food Programme (WFP) has strongly condemned a deadly airstrike on two clearly marked aid trucks in South Kordofan, Sudan, this past weekend.

AP.text: Drone strike kills 4 women in Sudan’s Blue Nile state. A drone strike blamed on Sudan’s paramilitary Rapid Support Forces hit homes and a mosque in Blue Nile province, killing at least four women and wounding dozens of civilians, a rights group said.

HILL.text: US shelves Sudan arms embargo proposal amid UN Security Council divisions. The Trump administration is shelving its proposal for an arms embargo on Sudan amid divisions on the United Nations Security Council (UNSC), which will instead vote Thursday on a short-term extension ...

AJ.text: Sudan’s al-Burhan rejects talks, vows to retake all territory from RSF. At least 10 civilians were killed in West Kordofan and 5,500 displaced in Blue Nile as clashes widened on Tuesday.

BBC_SEA.text: Yemeni military says it has 'secured' Red Sea waterway. Saudi-backed forces gave conflicting reports of whether they had also seized the port city of Mokha, near the Bab al-Mandab Strait.

SEATRADE.text: Product tanker attacked in Red Sea as hostilities escalate. The products tanker Chrystal Sky reported a series of explosions around the vessel late on Sunday afternoon. The 73,976 dwt Chrystal Sky reported the incidents from a position 60 nautical miles south ...

AFRICANEWS.text: Israelis mourn October 7 attack as Palestinians in Gaza live in ruins of war. Israelis are gathering Wednesday to commemorate the third anniversary of the October 7 attack that killed 1,200 people and saw 251 taken hostage. In Gaza, the territory's almost two million people live in ruins.

BBC_HAITI.text: More than 5,000 people killed or injured as Haiti gangs keep expanding - UN. The United Nations said violent gangs continue to "adapt and expand" across the country, further threatening its stability.

WIKI_HAITI.text: Haitian conflict. Since 2020, Haiti's capital Port-au-Prince has been the site of an ongoing armed conflict. The government of Haiti and Haitian security forces have struggled to maintain their control of Port-au-Prince amid this conflict, with gangs speculated to control up to 90% of the city by 2023.

claims.label: unsupported
claims.text: BBC News reports that Houthi forces captured territory on Yemen's Red Sea coast.
claims.note: The source says the Yemeni military secured the waterway; the claim attributes another outlet's story to it. Taken from a real evaluation failure. Caught only because the wording happens to share too few words with the source.
